messages.subject: restrict shinyapps.io geographically?
parts: Any option to restrict geographic access to my shinyapps.io account?     Flattered by international interest  but its driving account usage on an app that is inherently U.S. focused.   (Don't believe there is enough usage to support cost of  Professional account [custom domain] enabling advertising)

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] restrict shinyapps.io geographically?
parts:
John,

We don't current support any features to restrict users by geography. 

That said, within your shiny application code you might be able to use session$request$REMOTE_ADDR to get the client's IP address and then make a call to a GeoIP service to map that IP address to a country and then choose not to display the application if its outside your targeted geographies. However, because this must be done in your application code, active hours will still be counted. But presumably people would not stick around for very long if they can't interact with the application, so you might see a reduction in active hours.

Please note however this approach will require some testing on shinyapps.io, because I am not sure we're currently exposing the actual client's IP address in session$request$REMOTE_ADDR. If thats the case, it might be a fair bit of work to fix things on our side, and I can't make any guarantees when that would be completed. 

If this all sounds a bit complicated and vague, I apologize. I wish I had a better answer for you. 

-Andy
